segment_contamination_dimensions: Security and guard-duty buyer segment: siblings Office Cabin, Security Cabins, Portable Security Cabins, FRP Portable Security Cabin, Prefabricated Security Cabin, MS Security Cabins attract buyers seeking single-occupant guard or office enclosures — incompatible with multi-occupant worker housing buyers; names implying guard room, security booth, or office enclosure are discarded.

Specialist-function cabin buyer segment: siblings Telephone Booths, Smoking Cabin, Toll Booth, Frisking Booth, Portable ATM Cabin, Portable Dressing Room, Portable Kitchen, Portable Pantry attract buyers seeking single-purpose utility enclosures — incompatible with accommodation/sleeping-quarters buyers; names implying any of these functions are discarded.

Material-type generic cabin buyer segment: siblings PUF Cabin, FRP Cabin, GRP Cabin, GI Portable Cabin, PVC Portable Cabin, MS Porta Cabin, Wooden Cabins, Aluminium Office Cabins attract buyers searching by material alone without accommodation context — trade names 'Porta Cabin' and 'Portable Cabin' discarded from enhanced names as they match sibling names (Portable Cabin MCAT 35400, MS Porta Cabin MCAT 150852) and attract generic non-accommodation buyers.

Classroom and educational buyer segment: sibling Portable Classrooms attracts school/institution buyers seeking teaching spaces — incompatible with construction-site worker housing buyers; any name implying classroom or educational use is discarded.
